title: Auto Attack
features:
## Combat

- Auto Shovel Plants
- Auto Focus Defense
- Smart plant and boss targeting
- Automatic capybara lane movement
- DPS-based defense calculations
- Minimum-required unit deployment
- Donor-lane safety checks
- Boss priority targeting

## Deployment

- Auto Place Capybaras
- Auto Place Eggs
- Auto Hatch Eggs
- Smart lane selection
- Maximum five capybaras/eggs per lane
- Automatic full-lane avoidance
- Interrupted-placement recovery

## Boss Automation

- Auto Summon Bosses
- Select a boss or use Any Available
- Estimates boss health and available attack time
- Accounts for active enemies
- Summons only bosses estimated to be beatable
- Prioritizes the strongest available beatable boss

## Economy

- Auto Collect Money
- Auto Equip Best Plants
- Auto Buy Pots
- Auto Buy Lanes
- Automatic purchase confirmation
- Configurable money reserve

## Auto Sell

- Auto Sell Plants
- Auto Sell Capybaras
- Safe, Balanced, and Aggressive presets
- Rarity filtering
- Maximum-size filtering
- Favorite protection
- Mutation and effect protection
- Keep-best-copy protection

## Progression

- Auto Claim Playtime Rewards
- Auto Claim Daily Rewards
- Auto Claim Offline Rewards
- Auto Complete Quests
- Auto Claim Growth Rewards
- Auto Buy Tree Upgrades
- Auto Complete Bounties
- Auto Fusion

## Shopping

- Auto Buy Selected Eggs
- Auto Buy Selected Gear
- Auto Buy Traveling Merchant Items
- Multi-select shopping filters
